title: Independence Day, June 26 1960
description: Madagascar's independence from France was declared on June 26, 1960, as part of the wider decolonisation of Africa that year. Independence brought new possibilities for cultural production — including cinema — alongside the inherited structures of a colonial economy and administration. June 26 remains Madagascar's national day. The 1972 popular revolution, which ended what many considered a neo-colonial government, is a second founding moment whose significance runs through the work of the musicians and filmmakers who came of age in that period.
